parent_objective: design a bounded implementation route for audited offtrack guardrail repair specs without executing repair
blocked_by: M2372 accepts repair specs but no implementation route is designed
repair execution remains blocked until implementation levers and guardrail preservation are specified
supersedes: direct repair execution from repair-spec rows
training or scenario redesign that ignores collision/R4/diagnostic guardrails

public_gates: M2373 must design implementation levers for ordinary offtrack and mixed guarded repair specs without executing them
M2373 must preserve collision, R4 mitigation, and diagnostic no-ranking guardrails as constraints
M2373 must decide whether branch synthesis is required before any subsequent narrow implementation milestone
M2373 must keep ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns audited repair specs into a bounded implementation route without executing repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation design would require actor input changes or oracle features
stop if ordinary offtrack repair cannot be separated from collision/R4/diagnostic guardrails
stop if implementation route would directly rank profiles or packs
stop if design claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if the branch reaches cadence before another implementation milestone
route to repair-spec schema repair if implementation levers cannot preserve guardrails
route to artifact-only implementation materializer only if design is bounded and synthesis cadence allows it
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2372 accepts repair specs and routes to implementation design

admission_evidence: M2371 ordinary offtrack repair specs are 36
M2371 mixed guarded repair specs are 18
allowed_updates: M2373 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design or a synthesis route
next_stage_criteria: repair levers and guardrail constraints are mapped to implementation surfaces
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2373 designs implementation route and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2373; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2371 repair-spec artifacts and M2372 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Implementation design remains an engineering route, not driver capability evidence.
allowed_claims: bounded offtrack guardrail repair implementation design
no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares a bounded implementation route from repair-spec artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit or block an implementation materializer but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2373 cannot specify a bounded implementation route
M2373 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
M2373 selects another narrow implementation milestone after the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded implementation design can map audited repair specs to concrete repair surfaces while preserving collision, R4, diagnostic, and claim guardrails.
success_criteria: implementation levers are mapped for ordinary offtrack and mixed guarded specs
collision, R4, and diagnostic guardrails remain constraints
actor input, oracle-feature, profile-tuning, ranking, winner, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded follow-up route or branch synthesis route is selected
failure_criteria: M2373 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2373 executes repair levers or trains
M2373 changes actor inputs or injects hidden/oracle features
M2373 ranks support policies or controller families
M2373 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2373 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
